title: Autonomous Job Application Agent
body: A 7-module multi-agent system using LangGraph for orchestration and Claude Sonnet for reasoning. Automates end-to-end applications across LinkedIn, Xing, StepStone, Indeed DE. Browser automation via Playwright, Postgres-backed state, Next.js dashboard for monitoring.

title: AI-Powered Code Review Assistant
body: A GitHub Actions workflow that triggers an LLM-based code review on every PR — structured feedback on complexity, security, style. Reduced manual review overhead ~40% across a 6-engineer team. Calibrated prompts to surface real issues, not noise.
